changelog:
Reorganized settings into compact task-based sections with direct search destinations and remembered section navigation.
Separated System updates, backups, storage, diagnostics, logging, extension cleanup and reset into clear destinations.
Restructured parental controls around setup, content rules, schedules and recovery; improved prerequisite hints and temporary-access controls.
Hardened PIN verification against changed credentials, active lockouts and stale dialogs before saving protected changes.
Grouped player options by purpose and redesigned quick actions with a bounded scrolling menu, clearer Material icons, speed selection and focus handling.
Fixed rejected update toggles, stale summaries, cross-player mute ownership and obsolete search targets.
Moved profile-image imports off the UI thread with bounded atomic storage and stale-result rejection; fixed a settings-sharing shutdown race.
message: Dev build v847 - Reorganized settings, player controls and safer parental workflows
